dedupe_keys.name: peru and bolivia national dam inventory formatting scripts

description: This GitHub project prepares dam inventory tables from national source material in Peru and Bolivia. Its General README describes extracting records from reports, selecting identifiers and river, authority, use, height or capacity fields, and converting Peru coordinates from northing and easting to latitude and longitude. The tree lists country-specific Python scripts, intermediate spreadsheets and output workbooks. A modeller could adapt the scripts to construct dam locations and attributes for flood, water-storage or hydropower exposure scenarios. The root README is absent; the useful documentation is under General. It does not give exact registry source addresses, time stamps or the reuse terms of national data, and this review did not inspect workbook contents. An MIT file exists only under General, so it is not assumed to license the country folders or source tables. No scripts were executed. For simulation, output locations and units require checks against the original registers. Related resources are the original Peru and Bolivia inventories and the separate ESSD article linked by the project.
licence: MIT only in General/LICENSE for sample code; rights to country scripts and source registries are not expressly established.
